race.title: Bluegrass Relite Maiden Hurdle
race.title_full: Bluegrass Relite Maiden Hurdle (Turf) 4YO+ 2m 1f 105y Winner: €7,200 (20 runners)
race.analyst_verdict: BARLEY LANE cemented a very solid start to his career when third at Naas in January and with more to come upped slightly in trip, he looks the answer. Powerful Paddy will doubtless be popular having shaped well on debut for Willie Mullins recently, with Combs also of interest.
race.ip_hints_specific_pace: There is a chance of a pace burnout early, and Dubhain and Out Of Aces are two who could suffer: Such a hotly-contested pace as is on the cards here may be to the benefit of Hey Now and Keep Em Quite who can be expected to be ridden with restraint.
race.ip_hints_individual_pace: Ozark's Walk traded at 10% or less of Betfair SP twice and 25% or less of Betfair SP on 3 of its last 5 starts: Powerful Paddy traded at 10% or less of Betfair SP and 25% or less of Betfair SP on 2 of its last 5 starts.

races.title: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series at Punchestown Festival 2026 Qualifier Novice Handicap Hurdle
races.title_full: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series at Punchestown Festival 2026 Qualifier Novice Handicap Hurdle (Turf) 4YO+ 2m 4f 86y Winner: €9,000 (19 runners)
races.analyst_verdict: NEEDS MUST looked sure to play a hand in the finish when departing 2 out at Punchestown 6 weeks ago so must be considered off 1 lb lower. Welluknow and Campbell Black are also shortlisted in a competitive affair.
races.ip_hints_specific_pace: Irish Champ and Accustomed could capitalise from a more forward position than most: Of the better-fancied horses, Campbell Black is most likely to be ridden furthest from the pace.
races.ip_hints_individual_pace: Good Option traded at 25% or less of Betfair SP and 50% or less of Betfair SP 3 times on 4 of its last 4 starts: Accustomed traded at 25% or less of Betfair SP and 50% or less of Betfair SP on 2 of its last 5 starts.

races.title: Bluegrass Respire Handicap Hurdle (0 100) (Div 1)
races.title_full: Bluegrass Respire Handicap Hurdle (0 100) (Div 1) (Turf) 4YO+ 2m 4f 86y Winner: €6,000 (19 runners)
races.analyst_verdict: ASWELLASABENTLEY looked a bit unlucky not to go even closer when third here last time and gets the vote for Gavin Cromwell and Keith Donoghue. A market move for Gordon Elliott's new recruit Coppola would make him a potential threat. Jaynemax is respected on the back of her recent Leopardstown second, while Oliver McKiernan's Somersby Roost would also need considering if getting a run.
races.ip_hints_specific_pace: Of those forecasted with a better chance, Sunwalk and Bruno From Mars could be the most susceptible in a race in which competition for the lead looks plentiful: There is a chance of a pace burnout early, and Political Stance and Rockstown Girl are two who may benefit from being produced later.
races.ip_hints_individual_pace: Sunwalk traded at 10% or less of Betfair SP and 50% or less of Betfair SP twice on 3 of its last 5 starts: Political Stance traded at 10% or less of Betfair SP and 50% or less of Betfair SP on 2 of its last 4 starts.

races.title: Bluegrass Respire Handicap Hurdle (0 100) (Div 2)
races.title_full: Bluegrass Respire Handicap Hurdle (0 100) (Div 2) (Turf) 4YO+ 2m 4f 86y Winner: €6,000 (20 runners)
races.analyst_verdict: There were clear signs that BUTTON ROCK is getting the hang of things when fifth at Clonmel on his latest start in December and, with improvement anticipated now back up in trip for this handicap debut, he gets the nod. Fool Me Once's latest effort was hardly inspiring but he is on a good mark judged on bits and pieces of form, while Rebel Cowgirl has to be taken seriously on the back of her breakthrough success at Punchestown. Pleasureofpressure also enters calculations.
races.ip_hints_specific_pace: There is a chance of a pace burnout early, and Rebel Cowgirl and Kanog Bay are two who could suffer: Such a hotly-contested pace as is on the cards here may be to the benefit of Pleasureofpressure and Dolly Watkins who can be expected to be ridden with restraint.

races.title: Bluegrass Racehorse Cube Chase
races.title_full: Bluegrass Racehorse Cube Chase (Turf) 5YO+ 3m 2f 50y Winner: €9,600 (5 runners)
races.analyst_verdict: GERRI COLOMBE ran his most encouraging race of the campaign when runner-up in last month's Bobbyjo and can build on that and prove too strong for returning Grand National hero Nick Rockett.
races.ip_hints_specific_pace: In a race that lacks confirmed pace-forcers, Nick Rockett could get the run of things.
races.ip_hints_individual_pace: Gerri Colombe traded at 10% or less of Betfair SP and 25% or less of Betfair SP on 2 of its last 4 starts.

races.title: Bluegrass High Performance Rated Novice Chase
races.title_full: Bluegrass High Performance Rated Novice Chase (Turf) 5YO+ 2m 4f 86y Winner: €12,000 (8 runners)
races.analyst_verdict: Having won a C&D maiden on Boxing Day, SLANAGAIBHGOLEIR shaped as though still in top form at Gowran and he looks the way to go on these terms. I Am Lorenzo and Ayiko are feared most.
races.ip_hints_specific_pace: In a race that lacks confirmed pace-forcers, I Am Lorenzo could get the run of things: Of the better-fancied horses, Ayiko is most likely to be ridden furthest from the pace.

races.title: Bluegrass Resolve Cube Hunters Chase
races.title_full: Bluegrass Resolve Cube Hunters Chase (Turf) 5YO+ 2m 4f 86y Winner: €6,601 (8 runners)
races.analyst_verdict: The well-bred CAUSE FOR COMMENT has more to offer in hunters and can strike on the back of his pointing win last month. Ballyphilip and unexposed Sledgehammer are a couple of the other likely sorts.
races.ip_hints_specific_pace: There is a chance of a pace burnout early, and Cause For Comment is one who could suffer as a result: A strong early pace seems highly likely. Sledgehammer could be suited if held up as expected.
races.ip_hints_individual_pace: Cause For Comment traded at 25% or less of Betfair SP and 50% or less of Betfair SP on 2 of its last 3 starts.

races.title: Bluegrass Mare Prepare Mares Flat Race
races.title_full: Bluegrass Mare Prepare Mares Flat Race (Turf) 4YO+ 2m 1f 105y Winner: €6,601 (13 runners)
races.analyst_verdict: SURFIN USA has been off a long time since her encouraging debut second at Sligo but she's capable of better despite that absence and looks the way to go. Newcomers Lizzie Twigg and Viva Laa Vida are interesting rivals.
races.ip_hints_specific_pace: A decent pace still shouldn’t detract from the chances of those who race on or near the front end such as Surfin Usa: Louve D'arc might not benefit from being ridden as far back as usual for all the gallop is likely to be a reasonable one.
races.ip_hints_individual_pace: Louve D'arc traded at 25% or less of Betfair SP and 50% or less of Betfair SP on 2 of its last 2 starts.

Promising type. 3/1, third of 25 in 2m novice hurdle at Naas (soft) 67 days ago, unsuited by drop in trip. Sets a good standard for the rest to aim at back up slightly in distance.
Career best when winning 9-runner bumper at Fairyhouse (12/1) 157 days ago, in control long way out. Makes hurdles debut after leaving Martin Paul Fitzgerald and joining successful yard.
